capabilities.description: Syncs completed playback and optionally manual watched marks to AniList, and imports mapped watch history.
Checks the selected Silo profile for watched state when a player stops at zero. Connect with an AniList token and a Silo API key.

config_schema.title: Silo watched verification
config_schema.description: Use the same Silo account and profile as this watch-provider connection.

fields.label: Silo server URL
fields.description: The native Silo server URL reachable from the plugin, for example https://silo.example.com. Use HTTPS for remote servers.

fields.label: Silo API key
fields.description: An API key for the Silo account that owns this profile. Stored with this connection.

fields.label: Silo profile ID
fields.description: The ID of the profile you are connecting. Copy its id from GET /api/v1/profiles.

fields.label: Sync manually marked watched items
fields.description: Also send items marked watched without being played. The existing-entry restriction applies to both playback and manual marks when enabled.

fields.label: Playback completion threshold
fields.description: Playback must pass this percentage before AniList progress advances. Match Silo's watched threshold.

fields.label: Full import scan
fields.description: Rescan the complete AniList list on the next sync instead of only entries changed since the last scan. Turn off again afterwards to resume fast incremental syncs.

fields.label: Only update anime already on AniList
fields.description: Skip exports for anime absent from the connected account's list. Add titles to Plan to Watch before watching. Reduces unwanted additions from false matches; does not filter Silo libraries or watched-history imports.

presentation.summary: Reliably synchronize completed anime with AniList through Silo's watch-provider pipeline.
presentation.description_markdown:
Uses Silo's host-owned watch-sync pipeline for encrypted per-profile credentials, durable playback completion delivery, optional manual watched marks, retries, imports, and rich episode identity. Episode exports prefer the daily AniBridge v3 dataset, with an Anime-Lists and ARM fallback. Watch-history imports reverse-map AniList progress through AniBridge. AniList progress is monotonic and ambiguous mappings are rejected rather than guessed.

Community plugin by crowquillx (https://github.com/crowquillx/silo-anilist-sync), built for Bloem on the Bloem plugin SDK.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin and match the playback completion threshold to Silo's watched threshold. To connect a profile, open Settings → Watch Providers → AniList and select Connect. Silo shows a code and a button that opens the activation page; enter the code, approve access on AniList, and return to Silo — the connection completes automatically and shows your account. AniList tokens last about one year; reconnect when the credential expires. A manual paste flow remains documented in the plugin README as a fallback. For Neptune or Jellycompat players that report a stop at zero, connect the optional AniList with Silo watched check provider using an AniList access token, your Silo server URL, a Silo API key, and the current Silo profile ID. This connection checks saved watched state for that exact item and profile. See the README for setup; disconnect the ordinary AniList provider for that profile to avoid duplicate synchronization.
